Description
Strike fear and fascination with every coin. The Australian Perth Mint Wildlife Series — Deadly & Dangerous editions — celebrates the raw power of Australia’s most formidable creatures, rendered in stunning .999 fine silver by one of the world’s most respected mints.
Each 1 troy ounce coin is struck to brilliant uncirculated quality, featuring dramatic, highly detailed designs showcasing Australia’s most iconic and lethal wildlife — from the saltwater crocodile to the eastern brown snake, funnel-web spider, and beyond. These are not ordinary bullion coins. They’re miniature works of art that carry both precious metal value and serious collector appeal.
Whether you’re stacking silver or building a world-class collection, the Deadly & Dangerous series delivers undeniable visual impact. Each coin ships in its original Perth Mint packaging. Random year assortment — the exact year may vary, but the quality is always world-class
Design of the Australia 1 oz Deadly Dangerous Wildlife Silver Coins Coin .999 Random Years
The obverse features the effigy of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II by Ian Rank-Broadley, as is traditional on Perth Mint legal tender coins, accompanied by the coin’s face value and the year of issue.
The reverse is where the drama unfolds. A massive saltwater crocodile — the largest reptile on Earth and one of Australia’s most feared apex predators — is depicted in striking relief against a backdrop that captures its natural riverine habitat. The crocodile is shown with its powerful jaws agape, rows of razor-sharp teeth on full display, conveying the explosive, ambush-ready aggression this animal is legendary for. Intricate scale-by-scale detailing across the body showcases the exceptional craftsmanship Perth Mint is renowned for, with subtle textural contrast between the rough, armored hide and the smoother surrounding environment.
The design commands attention — equal parts scientific accuracy and raw artistic intensity. Light catches the frosted relief beautifully against the mirror-polished fields, giving the coin a dynamic, almost three-dimensional quality in hand.
The coin’s reverse inscription includes
SALTWATER CROCODILE
, the weight and purity designation
1 OZ 999 SILVER
, and the iconic
P
mintmark of the Perth Mint.
A true showpiece for any collector drawn to wildlife art, Australian silver, or simply one of nature’s most perfect killing machines rendered in precious metal.
Main Highlights of the Australia 1 oz Deadly Dangerous Wildlife Silver Coins Coin .999 Random Years
Contains 1 oz of .999 fine silver.
Minted by Perth Mint in Australia.
Available in Brilliant Uncirculated condition.
Sovereign coin backed by the Australian government.
